reason: My cousin in India already handles this for me through his CA, and it costs me next to nothing. Paying about CAD $340 to move 10 lakh doesn't make sense when I earn well and already have a way that works.
objection: Why pay 2% when my relative does it free? And it's a brand-new company, not even FINTRAC registered yet. I'd be trusting them with lakhs of rupees.
would_change_my_mind: A fee under about 0.7% with FINTRAC registration done and a track record from real customers. Or if my cousin stopped being able to help.
